relevance_note: Electron-microscopy study of plasma lipoproteins from two named patients with familial LCAT deficiency: "Although the structure of lipoproteins from both A. R. and A. A. was studied".
method_note: Hand extraction, no script transcription. Pre-molecular paper (OCR text with garbled passages: abstract, figure 2 legend and part of the Discussion are unreadable): no LCAT variant is printed or mentioned, so the variants table is empty. Two patients, A. R. and A. A., both with familial LCAT deficiency; patient-level clinical, lipid and renal data are said to be in the accompanying report (ref 1), not here, so all 20 checklist items are not reported. Micrographs are all from A. A.; for A. R. the only statement is that structures were 'comparable in both subjects', recorded as one observed feature inferred from that statement. The large flattened LDL particles are likened to LDL in biliary obstruction but never called lipoprotein X, so lipoprotein x is not reported. Publication year is not printed for this paper (only received/revised dates in 1970); year left null. First author printed as 'FOrTE' (OCR); recorded as Forte. Acknowledgments say Dr. S. Borsting 'conducted the dietary experiment' for A. A.; not recorded as treatment because nothing about it is described. Care in Oslo and Kristiansund is place of care, not stated origin, so ethnicity_or_country is not reported. No contradictions found.
